summary.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise thorough investigations. In northern Israel, Hezbollah submunitions exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing the teen and wounding dozens, prompting the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. The conflict has produced 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Hezbollah-eksplosiver som ble beslaglagt i to libanesiske lastebiler har fått Libanons statsminister og sikkerhetsstyrker til å love grundige etterforskninger. I Nord-Israel eksploderte Hezbollah-underammunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanons grense, noe som drepte tenåringen og såret dusinvis, og førte til at IDF-sjefen beordret en undersøkelse og myndighetene vurderer å begrense fotturer. Israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter mot Hezbollah-posisjoner i Sør-Libanon, og forårsaker sivile tap. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)
background.extract: An ongoing conflict between the Lebanese militant group Hezbollah and Israel began on 8 October 2023, when Hezbollah launched rockets and artillery at Israeli positions following Hamas's October 7 attacks on Israel. The conflict escalated into a prolonged exchange of bombardments, leading to extensive displacement in Israel and Lebanon. The conflict is part of the broader Middle Eastern crisis that began with Hamas's attack, with the short Israeli invasion of Lebanon in 2024 marking the largest escalation of the Hezbollah–Israel conflict since the 2006 Lebanon War. In Arabic, the conflict (2023–2024) is referred to as the "Support War" or the "Gaza Support War."
